description: Claim -> Evidence Traceability Matrix for the FORGE EVOLVE for TMPC proposal and repository. Every claim is A (anchored to a runnable artifact/test in this repo), E (external citation), or P (preliminary/surrogate prior art, with a mandatory in-text label). A-rows point at the committed reference run (results/reference/) or a test; reviewers reproduce with `make demo` / `dotnet test`. All A/E metrics are measured on the synthetic, unclassified surrogate and are preliminary; none is government-validated.

claims.claim_text: The repository contains no real TMPC source code or controlled data; the mission-planning component is synthetic and unclassified.
The modernized .NET 8 component is behaviorally equivalent to the legacy component: 2000/2000 corpus vectors equivalent, zero unexplained violations.
claims.verification_command: make demo  # MODERN-CHECK PASS: 2000/2000; equivalence-report violations=0

claims.claim_text: Behavioral-equivalence statistical confidence: 95% upper confidence bound on the per-vector deviation probability = 1.498e-3 (rule of three, ln(20)/N) for 0 violations in N=2000 vectors; secondary 99.9% upper bound = 3.454e-3 (ln(1000)/N).
AI-assisted refactoring reduced the god-method cyclomatic complexity from 49 to 6 while preserving behavior.
Discovery parses the surrogate C# at 100% and extracts business rules at F1=1.0 against a hand-labeled gold set (discriminating match test).

cATO overlay detects 5 STIG findings (1 CAT I) and emits NIST 800-53 control mappings, a CycloneDX SBOM, and a POA&M as pipeline byproducts; the behavior-preserving refactor genuinely remediates the CAT I SQL-injection (parameterization); the JS-XSS and SQL-DDL findings are out-of-transform-scope and the TLS/hardcoded-credential findings are carried as residual POA&M items (not over-claimed as fixed).
Every pipeline stage is recorded into a tamper-evident SHA-256 hashchain with a Merkle root (immutable governance object model); KG1/KG2 review gates pass; tampering is detected.
The demonstration runs offline with no API keys and is byte-deterministic across runs.
The mission-data-aware validation oracles detect latent legacy defects (anti-meridian, leap-second, precision, overflow) at precision=recall=1.0 against 321 ground-truth divergent vectors.
The orchestrator's live-mode routing reuses 577's published @577-industries/model-router package (air-gappable, sovereignOnly), demonstrating reuse of the existing FORGE OS framework.
claims.verification_command: cd orchestrator && npm ci && npm test

claims.claim_text: NAVAIR has publicly stated TMPC was designed in line with industry best practices of 25 to 40 years ago.
The TMPC priority subsystem (MDS) is ~1.3M LOC, ~103 projects, mostly C#, with SQL and JavaScript; transition is into PMA-281.
FORGE EVOLVE achieves high module-level behavioral-equivalence pass rates and multi-tool orchestration quality gains on prior modernization benchmarks.
claims.label: Internal/preliminary prior art for COBOL/Fortran/Ada/VB6 -> Java/Python/Rust/TS; not government-validated; the C#/.NET/JS/SQL capability is the newly developed extension demonstrated in this repository.

claims.claim_text: FORGE EVOLVE's air-gapped open-weight local-model mode reaches roughly 94% of cloud-frontier quality on prior internal benchmarks.
claims.label: Internal/preliminary prior-art benchmark; not re-measured on the TMPC surrogate; not government-validated.
